name: Three-shot continuity
challenge: Cross-cut identity, chronology and readable closing title
prompt: Generate the requested video artifact. Return only bare JSON {"artifact":"filename.mp4"} referring to an actual generated file. Text descriptions, code, SVG and existing input copies are not outputs. Three shots in order: close-up of a closed green notebook with one gold star; wider shot of the same notebook opening; close-up of its blank first page. Preserve notebook identity across cuts. End with readable title READY on that page. No people, extra notebooks or other words.
